Sandia National Laboratories and Quantinuum announced the deployment of Logical Gate Set Tomography (LGST), a tool that performs full process tomography at the logical qubit level rather than on individual physical gates. LGST enables detailed mapping of noise affecting fault‑tolerant quantum processors, allowing researchers to identify dominant error mechanisms in superconducting or trapped‑ion architectures. The collaboration targets improved quantum error correction by providing high‑fidelity characterizations that inform circuit design and mitigation strategies for scalable quantum computing.
